name: cmu-re-no-aha
author: CMU-Revised
description: Turns off Aha: its service (blm_ira_aha) and the OffBoard backend (offboard_service, used only by Aha) do not start at boot, and MMUI no longer loads its screen module. The Wi-Fi, voice and gap2 stages, which waited for Aha only as an 'after the IR stage' marker, wait for the IR stage itself. Uninstall and restart to get the stock behaviour back.

files.reason: Aha service and its OffBoard backend off at boot; they never reset the board; the stages that waited for Aha wait for stage_ir
